name: Cal.com
description: Persona, skill, and HTTP API tools that let an agent schedule meetings through cal.com's v2 API — list event types, check available slots, and create, list, get, cancel, and reschedule bookings. Because cal.com syncs with a connected destination calendar, bookings the agent creates appear in the user's Google Calendar (and availability respects Google busy-times). Authenticated by a single CALCOM_API_KEY.
